name: UPnP / DLNA

policy._this_is_a_policy: What to assume when the device has said nothing - not a measurement. A record that knows its own real figure wins.

note: Passes what the renderer accepts, so it imposes no ceiling of its own. But it cannot report buffer occupancy - only drop-outs, after the fact - so a zone on it is budgeted blind unless its link is measured.
